name: Björnrike

seo.title: Björnrike ski resort guide
seo.description: One of Vemdalen's three ski areas: 15 lifts and 16 slopes with its own village, on a SkiPass that also covers Vemdalsskalet and Klövsjö.
seo.twitterDescription: 15 lifts, 16 slopes, and the Vemdalen SkiPass covers two more areas.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, slope grades, where to stay and how to get to Björnrike in Jämtland, Sweden.

h1: Björnrike ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Björnrike is one of Vemdalen's three ski areas and has its own village at the foot of the slopes. Fifteen lifts serve sixteen slopes, three of the lifts are conveyor belts for beginners, and the same SkiPass reaches Vemdalsskalet and Klövsjö with Storhogna.
stayOverview: Björnrike is the quiet one of Vemdalen's three villages. Staying here puts the beginner lifts at the door and the other two areas a drive away on the same pass.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The SkiPass is Vemdalen's, so a bed here still buys you Vemdalsskalet's 470 metres of vertical.
rentalCars: A car is useful: Vemdalsskalet and Klövsjö are separate villages reached by road, not by lift.
